data.content: Observed 2026-08-24 on /Users/cartine/quilt: 50,921 full events (201 MiB), 32,754 index events (128 MiB), zero snapshot files, and 83,675 files scanned by every push. Recent full-event churn is commonly 1,000-2,500/day; 2026-08-18 produced 4,834 across 627 knots, led by state_set, tag_add, lease_id_set, created, and lease_data_set. Current compact --write-snapshots only appends active/cold snapshots. Critical trap: replication.collect_local_event_files scans all local files and copy_files_into_worktree would resurrect remotely pruned history from any stale machine. Incremental pull watermarks are Git commits, and lease quarantine retains per-knot base commits, so cutoff compatibility and unreachable ancestors need explicit design. Preliminary sizing: exploration/design effort 2; aggregate implementation effort 4, expected to split into manifest/schema, safe publisher/pruner, pull/bootstrap compatibility, and fixture/performance leaves.
